project: Light Remote rc50 MJS portability P0
scope: One enrolled device and one private local receipt root; no cross-host fencing

exclusiveLockRequiredDuring: read and validate entire receipt snapshot
check generation high-watermark and grant revision
dedupe commandId and signed command digest
reverify signed epoch, grant and expiry immediately before any OS side effect
perform only authorized and independently fenced action
reconcile upstream ACK without replaying uncertain physical actions
adapterInterface: acquireExclusive(scope) -> acquired locked native handle | LOCK_BUSY | ERROR
withSerializedReceipt(handle, auditedMutation) -> durable result | UNCERTAIN | ERROR
release(handle) -> terminal release, never delete a live lock inode
hardDenials: no PID or timeout based forced lock takeover
no receipt mutation through an unguarded path
never equate matching fd/inode with ownership of a kernel lock
no automatic replay of accepted or started work after crash
no real executor from the synthetic policy module
no production promotion based on Linux UAT alone
boundary.persistence: file fsync plus parent-directory fsync and corruption detection; a rename-before-dir-fsync failure is ambiguous
boundary.monotonicClockRequirements: Use authority-bounded lease freshness with monotonic checking and clock rollback tests; no local clock by itself proves online revocation

linux.candidate: native flock(fd,LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) on trusted private local filesystem
linux.testEvidence: Prior rc50 synthetic UAT reported PASS with SIGKILL, contention and inherited FD checks; not committed

darwin.candidate: native BSD flock(2) held in trusted helper over APFS-local receipt file

win32.candidate: CreateMutexExW with hardened Global\ namespace and explicit security descriptor; alternatively choose LockFileEx but not independent mixed schemes

decisionModel.proofAndLockFlags: TEST FLAGS ONLY, untrusted in production

fenceCoveragePlan.requiredGate: owner signed authority, transaction-bound device/grant generation, revocation
grant generation, signed device identity and receipt at dispatch/result
durable command envelope, generation-scoped delivery, device receipt reconciliation
durable once-only consumed-JTI and holder epoch transaction
verified provider signature, durable idempotency, accounting receipt and freeze
transactional outbox and provider delivery receipt, no double send
per tool/action authority, not HTTP method-only
